option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

items.description: One bullet per item: objects { name, value, target, max, ranges, color }. max is the end of the item's scale (default: 120 % of the target); ranges are its band boundaries in the units of the value, e.g. [600, 900].

title.description: Chart title. Leave blank for none.

orientation.description: Horizontal bars (one row per item) or vertical bars (one column per item).

percentOfTarget.description: Draw every item as a percentage of its own target, so that all targets line up at 100 % and items with different targets or units can be compared. The labels keep the real values.

ranges.description: Boundaries between the qualitative bands in percent of the target, for items without their own ranges. [75, 95] gives poor below 75 %, acceptable up to 95 %, good above.

bandColors.description: Colours of the bands from the lowest to the highest.

color.description: Colour of the bars, for items without their own color.

statusColors.description: Optional. When set, a bar takes the colour of the band its value is in, lowest band first, e.g. ["#e05252", "#e6a23c", "#3ba272"].

targetColor.description: Colour of the target markers. They carry a thin light outline so that they show on any background.

showValues.description: Write each value, and its percentage of the target, beside its bar.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
